mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.cityid AS cityId, i.baseid AS baseId, i.clinical_id AS clinicalId, c.name AS clinicalName, c.number AS clinicalNumber, i.person_id AS personId, i.type_id AS typeId, i.is_aging AS isAging, i.review_status AS reviewStatus, i.reviewer AS reviewer, i.is_report AS isReport, i.is_pm AS isPm, i.create_time AS createTime, i.update_time AS updateTime FROM think_items i LEFT JOIN think_clinical c ON c.id = i.clinical_id ORDER BY i.id
